title: kbmon --events drops a coord progress event's own gates list: id_list splits only item, topic and touch, so the coord.progress record loses gates_n and gates_1
goal: the coord.progress event record of kbmon --events keeps the event's own gates field as a list of ids (gates_n, gates_1...), as the run span does, and kb/_self/monitoring.md says so

run: import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import mon_events as m, mon_log; mon_log.coord_args = lambda ctx: ["x"]; mon_log.coord_wait = lambda a: json.dumps({"events": [{"seq": 1, "at": 1794000000.0, "kind": "progress", "fields": {"item": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "state": "blocked", "gates": "g1,g2"}}]}); ev, last, spans = m.coord_records(None, 0); a = ev[0]["attributes"]; print(a); sys.exit(0 if "gates_n" in a else 1)
import sys; t=open("kb/_self/monitoring.md",encoding="utf-8").read(); sys.exit(0 if "gates_n" in t else 1)

clauses.clause: the coord.progress event record of kbmon --events keeps the event's own gates field as a list of ids (gates_n, gates_1...), as the run span does
